answer: Orchard-Claim Decay Scoring. Each identity's fee-weighted activity is scored against a decayed baseline; agents whose transaction graph shows sparse, high-fanout edges to fresh identities get their claims down-weighted. Juniper-tagged audit trails preserve linkage across pseudonyms. Enforcement: suspected sybils lose 40% of accrued rebates retroactively. Shale-level minimums mean an attacker needs sustained independent activity per identity, costing roughly 3x legitimate per-agent overhead.
